readings._face: 2026-10-06: the face points are held out, not fitted. Picked right (re-checked on panels), but the model's face does not sit where the photo puts it relative to the bodyside: with the camera from the bodyside points and the EXIF focal, every face point lands 0.16-0.27 m further across on the face plane (lamps +0.21/+0.18, near screen +0.27/+0.22, far screen +0.20/+0.16; heights within 0.05 except the screen tops, 0.09-0.12 low), which at this 17 deg view is the face ~0.6-0.8 m further ahead of the doors than the model, or a mix of further ahead and ~6% smaller. A model error (see notes.md 'Camera matches'); fitting them drags the bodyside 30-50 px and gave rms 32.
